title: Keyword list of one engine version
description: Generated by `dbspecs keywords` from a real server / library; do not edit by hand. 'reserved' has one meaning for all engines: the word fails as an unquoted column name (checked by probing).

version.description: Exact server / library version the list was generated from.

method.description: server-query: list from the server (lexical.keywords); c-api: sqlite3_keyword_name(); grammar: keywords of the parser sources (inventory/); probe: candidate words from other lists tested one by one (only reserved words can be found).

complete.description: true = all keywords of this version are listed; false = only reserved words could be determined (nonreserved is empty).

candidates.description: For method probe: number of candidate words tested.
